observations: The top is unchanged for another day: Steal An Egg (93 days) leads ahead of Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, +1 Speed Keyboard Escape, Murder Mystery 2 and RIVALS.
There were no entries, exits or large moves today; the chart was the stillest it has been in the tracking window.
The age pattern stays U-shaped: the three games aged 0–14 days sit at the 92nd median percentile, 15–122 days at 26–48, and games past a year at 61.
BedWars, Phonk Edit Tower, What If Disasters (21 days) and Survive Overnight in a Mega Store are the weakest holders.
patterns: Games left more than about 10 days without an update consistently stay fewer days on the chart (r=-0.62 at the split; H-mp-018 at 65% tends to hold).
Pricier products and passes tend to go with longer presence (median product above 472 R$ r=+0.46; median pass above 77 R$ r=+0.48), with age as the main confounder.
combat_pvp (70), racing_driving (67), steal_defend_base (64) and roleplay_social (62) lead loops by median percentile, while wave survival (29), incremental_plus1 (31) and obbies (31) trail.

Long-running hits in the video set keep a light HUD in social and PvP games (Brookhaven, RIVALS, Adopt Me!) but a dense one in progression games (Blox Fruits, Hypershot), suggesting HUD density follows the loop rather than success.

outliers.name: Steal An Egg
outliers.note: A 93-day steal/egg template still leads the chart while its clones fall elsewhere; being first to the format seems to matter more than the format.

outliers.name: What If Disasters
outliers.note: At 21 days it sits among the weakest holders, matching the mid-life trough young games face once launch momentum ends.

observations: Donation hubs (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS) lead efficiency again, followed by Elemental Dungeons, Spin a KPOP Idol and Dinosaur Simulator.
Efficiency still rises with age: 33rd median percentile at 15–42 days, 41 at 43–84, 53 at 85–122 and 59 past a year (H-te-001 at 81%).
Movement was minimal: only Skibi Defense entered, and the biggest fallers lost a single place.
Fake an Egg (22 days), Violence District, Bike For Egg! and DONT SPLASH are the weakest earners for their player counts.
patterns: A median developer product above 79 R$ consistently goes with higher efficiency (r=+0.38 at the split; H-te-005 at 82%).
RPGs (r=+0.47) and roleplay loops (r=+0.30) consistently earn more per player, while Survival (r=-0.30), Simulation (r=-0.20) and solo loops (r=-0.24) earn less.
Longer descriptions, more and pricier passes, bigger servers and higher complexity all consistently go with efficiency, with age as a shared confounder.
'Egg' (r=-0.70) and 'Steal' (r=-0.40) titles carry the lowest efficiency, and steal_defend_base sits at the 19th median percentile among loops.

outliers.name: [🎃] Fake an Egg
outliers.note: On several charts at 22 days but the weakest earner per player, consistent with steal/egg templates buying reach rather than revenue.

outliers.name: THROTTLE (Beta) Moto Racing
outliers.note: A Simulation-genre game that earns well per player through cash packs up to 5,900 R$, a counterexample to H-te-027 and consistent with the bike-sim niche in H-x-010.

observations: PINKIE PROMISE (20 days) leads momentum at +29, followed by Keyboard Bridge Wars +26, SQUISHY DUMPLING PRISON RUN +18, A Long Flight +17 and Throw Food For Animals +16.
The youngest games carry the most momentum: 0–14 days at the 88th median percentile, 15–42 at 52 and 43–84 at 44.
Eight games entered, including Airport Security (Anomaly), NexRide, Catch a Plane!, roll the world and Find or Die!; Murder Mystery 2, Dress To Impress and Wanted fell off.
Solve The Cube -21, Kayak and Surf -18 and Rally Panic! -17 fell the furthest.
patterns: Shorter titles consistently go with higher positions within age bands (within-age -0.39; H-tt-037 at 67%).
Luck passes (within-age -0.53) and luck products (-0.33) tend to go against momentum and position, proposed today as a pass hypothesis next to H-tt-025.
Revives (H-tt-036 at 64%) and collection indexes (H-tt-028 at 67%) tend to go with stronger young games.
sandbox_physics (85), horror_escape (74) and wave survival (70) lead by median percentile, while job sims trail at 9, each from small groups.

outliers.name: [DUELS] Rally Panic!
outliers.note: Strong page, video and a novel two-role co-op idea, yet it fell 17 places at 24 days; its new Duels mode may be pulling it toward the PvP pattern that climbs slowly.

outliers.name: Keyboard Bridge Wars! 🧱
outliers.note: At 187 days it is outside the scored age range but rose 26 places, a reminder that party formats re-surface older games.

observations: DONT SPLASH (9 days) leads, ahead of Ragdoll Reality, The Hollow, PINKIE PROMISE, It Hears The Water and A Long Flight.
Cook the Chicken rose +47, Fart Together +25, My Bus +25 and PINKIE PROMISE +19, while Train Pets for Eggs -29, UNDERTALE Fight! -21 and Solve The Cube -20 fell.

Twelve games entered, including My Small Business (9 days, #42), Flying Tesla Roadster, +1 Shrink Worm Escape, Build An Anime Character and Steal A Pet And Ride It!; Bike Universe and Throw Food For Animals left.
Age bands are flat today (48–51 median percentile), so position differences come from the loop and updates more than age.
patterns: Frequent updates consistently go with higher positions (updates per week within-age +0.37; H-uc-015 at 71%, H-uc-012 at 75%).
Everyday-life roleplay (within-age +0.52) and physics sandboxes (+0.36) tend to rank high, while PvP (-0.26), core competition (-0.26) and 'play with friends' pitches (-0.35) rank lower.
Sports loops sit at the 5th median percentile across five games (Be a Soccer Manager, Bloxx League and others) despite strong like ratios, proposed today as a hypothesis.
Gameplay thumbnails tend to rank higher (+0.25 within age) while reward-flex ones rank lower (-0.26), which also weakened H-uc-010 and H-uc-011 today.

outliers.name: Be a Soccer Manager ⚽
outliers.note: A 98% like ratio on 22K votes and a deep manager loop, yet near the bottom; the sports-league loop and an older-skewing audience seem to hold it back.

outliers.name: Cook the Chicken (by slapping it)
outliers.note: No game passes and a 78% like ratio, yet the biggest riser at +47; a pure curiosity hook can still carry a young game upward.

summary: Physics sandboxes and horror lead both breakout charts: Ragdoll Reality and Realistic Ragdoll Engine sit high on Up-and-Coming and Top Trending, and horror_escape is now the largest loop on Up-and-Coming.
Games pull players first and monetize later: the youngest games lead Top Trending while Top Earning efficiency climbs from the 33rd percentile at 15–42 days to the 59th past a year.
Steal/egg templates keep buying reach without revenue: Steal An Egg leads Most Popular while Fake an Egg and Bike For Egg! are the weakest earners per player.
Halloween tags appear on most chart titles this week, a seasonal confounder for bracket-tag and update hypotheses.
progressions: uc→tt is now the most common transition (103 entries, median 2 days), just ahead of tt→mp (101, 2 days).
te→tt (67, 8 days), uc→te (66, 4 days), tt→te (65, 4 days) and uc→mp (64, 4 days) show breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
